title: 5x SDS (10 mL) Preparation
author: Haven Himmighoefer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kuycwxw

steps.title: Combine Tris, glycerol, and DTT
steps.instruction: In a 15 mL Falcon tube, add 1.667 mL of pH 6.8 Tris, 3 mL of 100 % glycerol, and 5 mL of DTT, then mix briefly.

steps.title: Add SDS and dissolve
steps.instruction: While in the fume hood, add 1 g of SDS to the mixture and shake until the SDS is completely dissolved (this may take a while).

steps.title: Adjust volume to 10 mL
steps.instruction: If the solution volume is below 10 mL, add de‑ionized water up to the 10 mL mark.

substeps.instruction: Add water to 10 mL mark if needed

steps.title: Aliquot and store solution
steps.instruction: Dispense 1 mL aliquots into Eppendorf tubes and store the tubes on the bottom shelf of the refrigerator.

substeps.instruction: Store on bottom shelf of fridge
